detailZh: 告诉我们你想做什么，一起选底板、镊子和需要的工具。
detailEn: Tell us what you would like to make. We will help you choose boards, tweezers and tools.

detailZh: 补齐下一幅图纸需要的豆子。请在备注里留下色号、品牌或图纸。
detailEn: Top up for your next pattern. Include your colour codes, bead brand or pattern in the notes.

detailZh: 挂绳、钥匙扣、冰箱贴配件等。款式与数量由店主确认。
detailEn: Straps, key rings and magnet fittings. We will confirm styles and quantities with you.

detailZh: 把你的想法告诉我们，聊聊定制的尺寸、配色和交付时间。图片为作品展示。
detailEn: Share an idea for a custom piece. We will discuss size, colours and timing. Photo shows example work.
